in_marathi.name: Bibekananda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom and Bliss
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bibekananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bibekananda is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Bibhak’ meaning wisdom and ‘Ananda’ meaning bliss. This name signifies the attainment of wisdom and the experience of ultimate happiness and bliss.
